trial_court: Senior Civil Judge, Dharmavaram, Anantapur District (OP No.106 of 2018); Family Court, Kadapa (M.C.No.44 of 2018)

parties.respondent_defendant: husband, respondent in OP No.106 of 2018

facts_of_case: Wife seeks transfer of OP No.106 of 2018 from Dharmavaram to Kadapa due to her inability to travel with a 9-month-old child; husband filed for restitution of conjugal rights; wife seeking maintenance

legal_principles.principle: The court may not transfer a petition to another court without sufficient grounds.
legal_principles.held: Therefore there are no grounds to transfer the OP No.106 of 2018 to Kadapa.

legal_principles.principle: In the absence of evidence to support a contention, it may not be granted.
legal_principles.held: there is no other material on record to show that the contentions raised in the petition have supported by any proof.

outcome.final_order: No transfer of OP No.106 of 2018; possibility of settlement between parties if counsel take initiative

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of proceedings in a matrimonial dispute
advising on the jurisdictional issues in a divorce case
assisting with the preparation of a response to a petition for transfer
